generatedWith: Built-in GPT image generation. Tool did not expose a specific model identifier.

integration.reason: Generated outlines are about eight percent narrower at equal height than the measured body. Do not stretch images or propagate this drift.

method: Read-only alpha analysis: longest contiguous alpha > 192 run per row; visible top/base require at least 35% of middle body width. Equal-height silhouettes, no image edits. This detects gross proportion drift; it is not dimensional certification.
observations: Clear and cobalt were generated sequentially, with cobalt edited from the new clear candidate.
Both have real exterior alpha; alpha alone does not provide refraction for internal components.
Some edge artifacts remain visible at full resolution.
Neck seat, shoulder and base must pass registration and component-state review before rollout.
